digest.component_or_area: LLM plan-review and code-review gates, model class resolution
propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries are hardcoded bare Anthropic model ids, causing resolvers to bypass provider configuration and always infer anthropic provider even when a different provider is configured
model_ladder[0] is copied directly to cfg.model in batch runners and DefaultBatchRunner, bypassing the resolution funnel and splitting the brain on provider for entry-rung assignment
models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic model names during escalation even when the primary is Bedrock-qualified, causing silent cross-provider escalation failures
class names (trivial, standard, frontier) as reserved values in the model-string space enable provider-portable ladder expressions when resolved through per-class configuration at runtime

MODEL_LADDER must remain a bare-name constant for substring matching in context-window lookup, while models_at_or_above must map rungs through class resolution to preserve provider affinity on escalation
